description: The command language for changing a bundle without editing its files by hand. Write a file {"commands": [ ... ]} and run: oebf apply <bundle> <file>. The bundle is validated before and after. If a command would leave it with a new problem, nothing is written.

add_path.description: Add a path made of straight segments through the given points. Closed joins the last point back to the first.

id.description: New path id, for example path-wall-garden

points.description: At least two [x, y] or [x, y, z] points in metres

add_element.description: Add an element that sweeps a profile along a path, and list it in the model.

parent_group_id.description: The storey or group to put it in. Default: the first storey

set_element_profile.description: Change the profile an element is swept with.

remove_element.description: Delete an element and take it out of the model. Its path and profile stay.
